content.title: About
content.content: The multigrain high‑fiber cookie is made from a blend of whole grains, oats, bran, and sunflower seeds. It has a crunchy texture, mild sweetness, and a rich nutty aroma. The product is suitable for a daily snack and can be incorporated into diets that emphasize fiber intake.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The cookie contains five different whole grains, making it more nutritious than typical sweet cookies.
Its fiber content supports a healthy gut microbiome.
No artificial colors or flavors are used.
It is vegetarian‑friendly but not gluten‑free.
Each serving (30 g) provides over 5 g of dietary fiber.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: High fiber promotes regular bowel movements and helps prevent constipation.

items.title: May lower cholesterol
items.content: Soluble fiber from oats can help reduce LDL ("bad") cholesterol levels.

items.title: Sustained satiety
items.content: Fiber slows carbohydrate absorption, keeping you feeling full longer.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: The multigrain blend provides thiamine, niacin, and folate, essential for energy metabolism.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Sunflower seeds and bran are rich in vitamin E and phenolic compounds that protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Allergy to grains or seeds
items.content: The product may contain traces of wheat, oats, and sunflower seeds, which should be considered by individuals with relevant allergies.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Despite its high fiber, the cookie contains added sugar; people monitoring blood glucose should account for it.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: The cookie is relatively calorie‑dense (about 150 kcal per 30 g), so moderation is advised.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the cookie as a standalone snack, crumble it into yogurt, kefir, or muesli, or use it as a crunchy base for desserts. For a softer texture, lightly warm it in the oven.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the cookies in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. For longer shelf life, keep them refrigerated to maintain crunch and prevent fat oxidation.
